{{nihongo|'''Yuzusame Shrine'''|由豆佐売神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Dewa Province]].

=== Enshrined deities ===
*Center seat: {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Mizokuihime-no-Mikoto}} (みぞくいひめのみこと)
*Left seat: {{ill|Ōkuninushi|lt=Ōnamuchi-no-Mikoto|qid=Q276944}}
*Right seat: {{ill|Sukunabikona|lt=Sukunahikona-no-Mikoto|qid=Q3275687}}

=== Overview ===
It is said to have been founded in {{ill|Hakuchi (era)|Q540118|qid=Q540118}} 1 ({{ill|650|Q30179|qid=Q30179}}). It was formerly called Kannon-dō, Yukura Gongen, Ryūzō Gongen, and from old times has been revered by local residents as the shrine protecting {{ill|Yutagawa Onsen|Q11563759|qid=Q11563759}}. Its former rank under the {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|Q712534|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines}} was gōsha (ranked in {{ill|Meiji era|Q3125096|qid=Q3125096}} 9 / {{ill|1876|Q7766|qid=Q7766}}), and it is also a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}} recorded in the ''{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}'', making it a shrine of long-standing tradition. The current main sanctuary was expanded in Meiji 15 ({{ill|1882|Q7812|qid=Q7812}}) by master shrine carpenter Takahashi Kanekichi.

In late April 2002 (Heisei 14), location filming for the movie ''{{ill|The Twilight Samurai|Q94033|qid=Q94033|lt=The Twilight Samurai}}'' was carried out at this shrine<ref>[https://www.yamagata-np.jp/feature/fujisawa_sekai/kj_2017040600239.php 藤沢周平没後20年、生誕90年] Yamagata Shimbun (April 6, 2017)</ref>. An information board on the approach records details of the filming at that time.
